title: Form action with useActionState
summary: Submit a form through an action, track pending state and show the result.
prompt: Finish `NewsletterForm` with `useActionState`. Its action reads `email` from `FormData` and awaits `subscribe(email)`. While pending, the button is disabled and reads "Subscribing…". On success, show `role="status"` with "Subscribed <email>". On failure, show `role="alert"` with the error message.
hints: `const [state, formAction, isPending] = useActionState(async (previous, formData) => {…}, initial)`, then `<form action={formAction}>`.
Return the next state from the action. A thrown error would go to the nearest error boundary, so catch it and return it as state.
